item.text: {"issues":[{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"yes","description":"Users report being unable to sign in because their password is rejected or account access is blocked.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"TMP_ACCESS_01","issue_name":"Account sign-in problems"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Examples mention frequent or intrusive ads, limited song selection controls for non-subscribers, and difficulty navigating directly to a song.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["a3605554-5c3a-441d-836e-e9fdea83eb2e","94c9f2f9-36fa-4c11-936e-660514fe7a35","ebc64fe2-9553-4528-87d5-cb4bb9783be6","5c9c17d3-9d6a-4fa1-a2a4-ae98eefbbd25"],"issue_id":"TMP_USABILITY_01","issue_name":"Ads and listening controls"},{"actionable":"no","coherent":"no","description":"Examples cover playback interruptions, loading and launch failures, control behavior, assistant playback, and background downloads, alongside a vague inability-to-play complaint.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["2ffdf599-a0d5-4c01-bf26-025215d44c06","9c9757da-6b99-4c95-a0e7-0661ee858027","46ff0c74-5e86-4e5b-b4cd-36201aab0f9e","9e5f9745-f8be-48d3-b9de-4d118507d94a","55cc3abf-c295-4591-8c3a-78085cfdefaa","d455c11e-c530-4c03-a395-38f5a5cdb8d3","4ab2089a-ffa8-49e7-a8a3-aeb583a96796","66a29b3c-c14d-440e-b722-b23e0c99ae82"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_01","issue_name":"Playback and app behavior"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"yes","description":"A user reports that offline listening is not working.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01","issue_name":"Offline listening failure"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Examples report missing songs, limited gospel music, and lyrics that are absent or fail to appear, as well as vague praise and dissatisfaction with recommendations.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["7a833667-4fcb-4a40-a88d-c55cfeca3d16","618d1dbb-0186-4537-923a-7b4dabf19afb"],"issue_id":"TMP_CATALOG_01","issue_name":"Catalog and lyrics gaps"}]}
